title: FRIDAY Voice Provenance Record V1
description: P2-M5V9-B.3D.2. See docs/voice-v2/FRIDAY-V2-PROVENANCE-SPEC.md. One record documents one recording session's provenance. Contains NO raw contract/agreement text and NO real performer PII — speaker_id, engineer, and rights_record_id are opaque references that resolve only in secure, private, non-repository legal/document storage.

provenance_id.description: Unique identifier for this provenance record.

speaker_id.description: Opaque reference to the performer. NEVER a real name.

rights_record_id.description: Opaque reference to the signed rights agreement covering this session. The agreement's actual content lives outside this repository entirely, in secure, private legal storage.

studio_or_location.description: Generic label, never a home address.

engineer.description: Opaque reference, not necessarily a real name.

rights_scope_summary.description: Short, non-legal-text summary only. Informational — the linked rights_record_id's actual agreement is authoritative, not this summary.

notes.description: Free text. Must never contain contract text or real PII.
